_status: v1 (Tomas r3; recipe unchanged in r4): the Blackthorn of gin, sloe gin, dry vermouth and orange bitters, one of the five Oxford lists from Trader Vic's 1947 guide (BLACKTHORN COCKTAIL pdf 280; no measures there or anywhere in the library, these are mine; peel from Oxford's recipe for Smith's version).
